thread:
alex-chang: Hey team — Kickoff for the SI onboarding with NorthStar Solutions + IronRacks (hardware). Need a compact, publishable Terraform + marketplace bundle, ops runbook, and a short joint announcement timeline. Meeting Thurs 2pm PT. Deliverables: terraform module, one-click marketplace template, console docs, telemetry hooks, and a draft press blurb. Can we align owners?

samira-k: I can own the terraform module and the marketplace template. will fork refkit and produce a minimal module that supports both cloud and IronRacks bare-metal.

jordan_lewis: I will handle KMS/HSM integration notes for IronRacks and the security checklist. Need to confirm HSM API compatibility on bare-metal.

meenal: I'll take announcement + partner comms. question: do we want an embargo or coordinated public launch? also need partner logos and approved quotes. :speech_balloon:

alex-chang: Good Q — tentatively embargoed until legal signs off, but plan for a staged launch: 1) private early-access customers (2 weeks), 2) public marketplace listing + blog post. Ops: ensure rollout can be toggled per-customer.

liz-product: From product side — add a small quickstart in Console (one-click deploy) + screenshots. I can own the Console quickstart content. ETA: 1 week after module PR.

samira-k: Draft terraform snippet for module interface (WIP):
```hcl
module "northstar_onramp" {
  source    = "github.com/redwood/refkits/marketplace//northstar?ref=v0.1.0"
  region    = var.region
  node_pool = var.node_pool
  hsm      = var.hsm_enabled
}
```
This will support cloud providers and a minimal bare-metal mapping. I also plan to include a `module-output` that wires telemetry (datadog/newrelic) hooks.

jordan_lewis: Nice. For HSM/KMS we should surface `kms_key_arn` and a `hsm_provider` enum. Also add a small security runbook snippet:
```
- Validate HSM provisioning with partner API
- Ensure keys are customer-isolated (no shared master keys)
- CI pipeline must have an HSM acceptance test (dry-run)
```

meenal: For comms: I'll draft a ~200 word partner blurb + a short FAQ for marketplace listing. Need partner legal + marketing assets by Tue. I'll also coordinate a joint announcement calendar with partner PM (target public date = 2 weeks after early access). :calendar:

ops-bot: Reminder created: PRJ-1234 "NorthStar onramp - marketplace bundle" assigned to samira-k, due 7 days.

alex-chang: Action items summary:
- samira-k: terraform module + marketplace template (PR + tests)
- jordan_lewis: security/HSM runbook + KMS mapping
- liz-product: Console quickstart + screenshots
- meenal: partner comms, press blurb, FAQ
- alex-chang: coordinate legal/early-access list + partner sync
- ops-bot: create checklist/tracking ticket (done)

alex-chang: Quick ask before Thu: if you have a short repo name preference for the marketplace package (<= 16 chars) reply here. I'll consolidate into the kickoff notes and send invites. :rocket:
